name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
summary: Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith stationed along the snowy roadway leading from Coldridge Pass toward Kharanos. He maintains a busy shooting range and equips local hunters and mountaineers with firearms and ammunition.

sections.title: A Gunsmith on the Road
sections.body: Set up at a small campsite between Coldridge Pass and Kharanos, Hegnar Rumbleshot caters to dwarven marksmen, travelers, and the local militia. His camp features a popular shooting range where mountain folk hone their aim against the wild beasts prowling Dun Morogh. Supplying so many eager shooters means Hegnar burns through munitions at a brisk pace, leaving him perpetually reliant on fresh shipments of ammunition from his supplier, the gnome engineer Loslor Rudge.

faq.answer: Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith who operates an outdoor target range and camp along the main path between Coldridge Pass and Kharanos.

faq.q: Where does Hegnar get his ammunition?
faq.answer: Hegnar relies on Loslor Rudge, a gnome engineer stationed in Coldridge Valley, to manufacture and supply the ammunition needed to keep his shooting range running.

faq.q: What does Hegnar do for the local dwarves?
faq.answer: He outfits local hunters and militia members with firearms and shot, while providing a practice range for marksmen traveling through Dun Morogh.

angles.text: For marksmen heading out from Coldridge Valley into the wider snowy peaks of Dun Morogh, Hegnar provides essential shot, ammunition pouches, and spare firearms.
Dwarves take pride in craftsmanship and marksmanship, making Hegnar's roadside practice range a natural gathering spot for travelers looking to test their triggers.
